verification.sourceBaseline: hddt_conn_v1.3.0-rc.1 plus selected-only export and item-code reporting patch

legacyWarning: Files and documents describing older portable/local/VM300 releases are retained as historical source context; follow the current deployment documentation for this release.
customizations: Retains the existing /admin WebUI and TVAN Catalog DB functionality from the rc.1 source baseline.
Moves invoice row selection to the application level so the selected invoice set is shared across invoice, download and accounting-export pages.
Bulk Excel, TVAN PDF and XML/ZIP operations consume only the selected invoice set.
Accounting report/profile exports and on-screen summaries consume only the selected invoice set.
Adds InvoiceLine.itemCode as the Mã hàng hóa/dịch vụ column in the ChiTiet Excel sheet and preserves it as text.
Shows Mã hàng hóa/dịch vụ in the HHDV detail modal and accounting HHDV report.
Adds an export unit-test assertion for itemCode value and Excel text formatting.
Updates source packaging output naming to hddt_conn_v<version>.zip using VERSION dynamically.
knownLimits: A selected invoice without hydrated detail lines can still be exported, but its ChiTiet rows are unavailable until detail is loaded.
TVAN PDF batch remains subject to provider capability, CAPTCHA and the existing batch request limit.
AMIS profiles remain foundation mappings until an official verified workbook is provided.
Full dependency-enabled verify/build must be run in the target CI or deployment environment before production acceptance.
